entries.en: They fried that drone to a crisp. Took it apart, almost nothin’ worth savin’.
entries.ro: Au prăjit-o pe drona aia, rămas scrum. Au desfăcut-o, aproape nimic de salvat.

entries.en: But you grabbed the data, right?
Uh, yeah... A li'l corrupted, but most of it's there. Should pay up.
entries.ro: Eh, da... Un pic corupte, da' majoritatea e acolo. Ar trebui să plătească.
